```{r}
library('ggplot2')
library('reshape2')
library("scales")
library('tidyquant')



cichlid_colours = c('#C3BE46FF', '#4D4D4DFF',  '#00CCFF') # calliptera, Ramphos, zebras

```



```{r}
import <- function(fname, channel) {
  data <- read.csv(fname)
  
  # select only the channel of interest
  data <- data[c(1, channel + 3)]
  
  #rescale both channels
  data[[1]] <- rescale(data[[1]])
  data[[2]] <- rescale(data[[2]])
  
  #convert column names for easy plotting 
  colnames(data) <- c('AP_position', 'Expression')
  
  return(data)
}
```

```{r}
metadata <- read.csv('data/metadata.csv')
# remove lines we don't want 
metadata <- metadata[!metadata$skip,]


data <- data.frame()

ndim = dim(metadata)[1]

for (i in c(1:ndim)){
  # extract all metadata from the file 
  fname <- paste('data/', metadata[i, 1], sep='')
  channel <- metadata[i, 2]
  genename <- metadata[i, 3]
  embryo_name <- metadata[i, 4]
  species <- metadata[i, 5]
  stage <- metadata[i, 6]

  # import the data and add metadata
  dat <- import(fname, channel)
  dat$species <- species 
  dat$gene_name <- genename 
  dat$name <- embryo_name
  dat$stage <- stage
  

  data <- rbind(data, dat)

    
}

data$species[data$species == "R. chillingali"] <- "R. chilingali"

```




```{r}
ggplot(data[data$gene_name %in% c('tbx16', 'tbx6'),], aes(x = AP_position, 
                 y = Expression, 
                 color = species, 
                 group = name)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.1) + 
  geom_ma(ma_fun = SMA, 
          n = 20, 
          linetype = 'solid', 
          linewidth = 0.5) + 
  facet_wrap('gene_name', nrow = 2) + 
  # facet_grid(name~gene_name)+
  theme_bw() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = cichlid_colours) + 
  xlab('Position (AP)') + 
  ylab('Expression (AU)') + 
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', 
        legend.title=element_blank(),
      legend.margin = margin(-5, 0, 0, 0)
      )+
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
#top, right, bottom, left
#top, right, bottom, left
scale = 1.6

ggsave('../graphs/Fig5C.png', 
       width = 2.8*scale, 
       height = 6*scale, units= 'cm', dpi = 600)
```
